reg.reason: POST /api/auth/register is not served by the target: Replaced by Cognito Sign UP（D-1/R-4）。目标不建这个资源；裁判的注册步骤只在单体侧运行，目标侧的同一用户由上面的 identities 准备。单体的 201 {message,user{userId,email,name},accessToken,refreshToken} 契约由 Cognito SDK 的输出取代，400/409 校验臂（email 格式、密码长度、邮箱占用）不再由目标 API 应答。 (replaced by cognito)
